text:
marta: Quick heads-up — after landing the Obsidian adapter merge into the int8 runtime build we started seeing customer repros where the instruction text jumps or reorders after ~1k tokens. Repro attached below. Anyone run into this pattern before?
ci-bot: deploy: obsidian-lora @ int8-smoke -> canary started (build 2026.03.07-obs-19)
lee: can you paste the minimal repro command & flags?
marta: repro command:
```
redwood run --model obsidian-base:rev-12 --adapter obsidian-lora:v2 \
  --quantize int8 --max-tokens 2048 --prompt-file tests/long_instruct.txt
```
observed behavior: instruction text "moves" mid-output around token ~1100; sometimes repeats previous sentence.
oliver: my first guess is a past_key_values dtype/offset mismatch when concatenating KV caches across quantized layers. The int8 path stores KV buffers differently — did the adapter introduce any custom past-KV handling?
julia: ran a small quick-pack (long_instruct, 20 prompts):
- fp16 baseline: 0/20 shifts
- int8 w/ adapter: 7/20 shifts (mostly after ~1k tokens)
- int4 experimental: 0/20 shifts but large accuracy changes elsewhere
median perplexities (fp16 / int8): 12.3 / 13.5
sam: paused canary routing for Orbital/Obsidian tenant; routing to fp16 fallback until we have a fix :white_flag:
arjun: two quick probes to run: 1) dump past_key_values dtype & shapes immediately before concat (small runtime hook). 2) bisection between adapter-merge commits to find the first bad commit.
lee: if it's a dtype mismatch, a fast mitigation is casting past_KV to fp16 prior to concat. Cheap patch to reduce customer impact while we root cause.
marta: i'll add a debug-hook and try the cast patch on canary. Also wondering about positional indexing: could quantized kernels pad blocks or change block math such that positional offsets drift?
oliver: yep — some int8 kernels pad to block sizes. If index arithmetic doesn't account for padding you can end up with off-by-pad offsets in the KV cache. Also watch for inplace ops around layernorm->kv that change buffer offsets.
julia: short result table from the 20-run (attached):
```
prompt_id | baseline | int8 | notes
001       | ok       | shift@1152 | repeated clause
002       | ok       | ok         |
003       | ok       | shift@1089 | instruction truncated
```
marta: applying cast-patch now on canary (build 2026.03.07-obs-19a) and re-running the 20-pack. console: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/obsidian/2026-03-07
sam: :eyes: keep updates coming. We'll keep fallback in place until green.
arjun: even if cast fixes it, we should add a long-context unit that validates pastKV offsets/padding (smoke test >2k tokens) to eng-ml nightly.
lee: agreed — add to the nightly smoke pack and a short regression test for KV concat dtype.
marta: repro session in ~20m for anyone who wants to watch; i'll share the session link then.
oliver: i'll join
julia: joining now
sam: standby
ci-bot: canary update: 2026.03.07-obs-19a deployed -> running smoke suite 20/20
marta: initial 20-run with int8+cast -> 1/20 shift (single outlier). collecting logs for that one and diff vs fp16.
lee: when you have the outlier log, drop the snippet here (especially the pastKV shapes & dtype prints).
marta: will follow up with full logs, the debug dump, and a commit-range bisection result.
arjun: nice triage tempo, appreciated. Once we confirm root cause we should add a small canary that runs long-instruct pack on every int8 adapter merge. :thumbsup:
